title: Examples api is broken
body:
### **Describe the bug**
```

error[E0026]: variant `MenuEvent` does not have a field named `window_id`
    --> core/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs:1505:7
     |
1505 |       window_id,
     |       ^^^^^^^^^ variant `MenuEvent` does not have this field

error[E0026]: variant `MenuEvent` does not have a field named `window_id`
    --> core/tauri-runtime-wry/src/lib.rs:1521:7
     |
1521 |       window_id: _,
     |       ^^^^^^^^^ variant `MenuEvent` does not have this field


```
### **To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

Steps described in readme to compile and run examples/api

### **Platform and Versions (required):**

Macos
yarn info v1.22.10
rustc 1.52.1 (9bc8c42bb 2021-05-09)  (1.53 also used)
